# Support

Lakana is an open-source project with one maintainer. Support is best effort: no service
level, no warranty and no response times, before v1.0.0 and from v1.0.0 onwards.

- Questions: open an issue with the Question template.
- Ideas: open an issue with the Feature request template.
- Bugs: open an issue with the Bug report template.
- Security problems: see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/lakana-labs/lakana/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md); do not open a public issue.

What to expect, which versions and platforms are covered, and what third parties may do
around Lakana: [docs/site/explanation/support.md](https://github.com/lakana-labs/lakana/blob/main/docs/site/explanation/support.md).
